title: Ultrarapid deep 3D histology enables intraoperative mapping of glioma infiltration.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo API record 21132396: CC-BY-4.0 licence, exactly 3 files (Oligodendroglioma.tif, astrocytoma.tif, Glioblastoma.tif), each 3,139,642,284 bytes (~3.1 GB). Did not download (over 50 MB cap). No label/annotation files in the record.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Paper is paywalled (no PMCID, no full text in Europe PMC). Data availability (via search snippet of the paper): representative images on Zenodo, code on GitHub (Zhijie-Liu/Ultrarapid-Deep-3D-Histology), all other raw data 'available from the lead contact upon request'. Zenodo description: virtual H&E (hematoxylin and eosin stain) images generated from SRS (stimulated Raman scattering) lipid channel, 0.414 µm/pixel, 1 mm depth, 1 µm z-step.

a1_downloadable.note: Only 3 representative volumes are public; the full patient cohort's raw data is 'available on request' (paper statement, not verified beyond Zenodo listing).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Zenodo files are image volumes only; no infiltration or margin annotations. A label would have to be constructed (checked file list only).

a3_inputs_present.note: Images themselves are the inputs, present as TIFFs (per Zenodo listing; not opened).

a4_units_stated.note: Pixel size 0.414 µm and 1 µm z-step stated in Zenodo description.

a5_enough_rows.note: 3 specimens, one per glioma subtype, verified in Zenodo file list. Tiles could be cut, but the independent unit is the patient: n=3.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~9.4 GB for all three TIFFs; streamable by tile
a6_fits_laptop.note: Feasible with tiled reading, but moot given A1/A2/A5.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Paper cohort size unknown (paywalled); public data is explicitly a representative subset, so it cannot match the paper's cohort.

a8_label_provenance.note: The public images are virtual H&E produced by the authors' own model from SRS images, so any label derived from them is downstream of a model output.

existing_models.name: FastGlioma (MLNeurosurg, Nature 2024), a visual foundation model for SRH (stimulated Raman histology)
existing_models.score_and_split: Mean ROC AUC (area under receiver operating curve) 92.1% for infiltration detection on a prospective multicentre cohort of 220 patients (per GitHub/search snippet).

existing_models.name: OpenSRH benchmark (NeurIPS 2022 Datasets track), 300+ patients, 1,300+ SRH slides
existing_models.score_and_split: Patient-level benchmark splits; numbers not retrieved.

backbone.name: FastGlioma SRH foundation model (2D)
backbone.hardware: CPU possible for 2D tiles; 3D volumes heavy
backbone.licence: Data CC-BY-4.0 (Zenodo); FastGlioma licence not checked

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Would a 2D SRH infiltration model transfer to cleared 3D SRS volumes? Not testable with 3 unlabelled volumes.

honest_claim_h3: With 3 unlabelled representative volumes, no supervised claim can be made; at most a qualitative demonstration on three specimens.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use 3D label-free microscope images of glioma tissue to predict how deeply tumor cells infiltrate surrounding brain.
plain_idea.train_on: Volumetric virtual-stained tissue images; only 3 specimens (one per glioma subtype) are public, verified on Zenodo.
plain_idea.predict: Per-region tumor infiltration, which would need pathologist annotation or immunostaining; no such labels are released.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Neurosurgeons could judge resection margins during surgery; but this release can't support training or testing such a model.

more_or_better_data.why: 3 public volumes versus OpenSRH's 300+ patients and FastGlioma's 220-patient prospective test cohort.

confidence_score.why: No replicates or labels to estimate uncertainty from.

models_beatable.why: FastGlioma (2024 foundation model, prospective multicentre evaluation, AUC 92.1%) is recent and honestly evaluated.

guaranteed_improvement.why: No labelled data measuring the same quantity; imaging modality (cleared 3D SRS) differs from FastGlioma's 2D SRH.

ml_idea: Transfer a 2D SRH infiltration model to 3D cleared SRS volumes; blocked by only 3 unlabelled public volumes and raw data on request.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A from the Zenodo file listing.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count public labelled specimens on Zenodo: 3, unlabelled — already done, kills it.

verdict_reason: Public data is 3 representative unlabelled 3 GB TIFF volumes (one per subtype, verified on Zenodo); full cohort is on request, so A1, A2 and A5 fail.
